admission_basis: One bounded worker improves the root task enough to repay packet and merge cost.

root.work: Mission custody, cross-cutting analysis, merge, and verification.

workers.return_condition: Return the result, evidence, uncertainty, conflicts, and touched state.

budgets.model_policy: Use the least expensive qualified route without lowering acceptance.
budgets.stop_condition: Stop or re-plan when coordination cost exceeds expected benefit.

merge.method: Reconcile claims and authoritative state, then verify the integrated result.

next_move: Dispatch the ready frontier through the live host contract.
